leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to specify the structure and types of form data objects.
Implement controlled form components using useState hooks to manage input values.
Apply event handlers to capture and process user input from form elements.
Utilize form submission handlers to prevent default browser behavior and process form data.
Construct validation functions that check form data against specific rules and criteria.
Execute conditional rendering to display validation error messages based on form state.
Use TypeScript generics with useState to maintain type safety for form state management.
Implement real-time validation by invoking validation logic within change event handlers.
Control form submission flow by conditionally enabling/disabling submit buttons based on validation status.
Store validation results in component state to track and display multiple error conditions.
Compare form field values against validation rules to determine input validity.
Return structured form data from submission handlers for further processing or API calls.
